description: This file defines the PdfFileSpecification class, part of the PdfSharp library, representing a file specification dictionary used in PDF document processing. It includes methods for initializing and managing embedded file streams within PDF files.

classes.name: PdfFileSpecification
classes.description: Represents a file specification dictionary used for referencing embedded files within a PDF document.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined key names for the file specification dictionary.

methods.name: PdfFileSpecification
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new file specification referencing an embedded file stream.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dictionary entries for the file specification, including type, name, and embedded file references.
